opening.argument: The segment presents a clear financial-news report: it announces that the Federal Reserve would be “temporarily lifting the asset cap on Wells Fargo” to permit more emergency lending through the Paycheck Protection Program, while also noting that the treatment would apply to Main Street lending. The discussion of Wells Fargo’s unauthorized customer accounts is historical context explaining the earlier cap, not an offer or solicitation. The closing request to “click right here to subscribe to our Yahoo Finance YouTube channel” is ordinary channel engagement; it is not presented as a condition for financial services, investment returns, or any other promised benefit.
